title: TopologyV2ResolveRequestPatch
description: A partial resolve request used by drilldowns to override/inject request fields for the target view resolve. Fields are optional; when absent, the UI should inherit the current resolve request values.

scopeType.description: Optional scopeType override for the target resolve. Typically a literal TopologyV2ScopeType value (e.g., "site"), but may also be a client-evaluated expression (e.g., "request.scopeType").

scopeId.description: Optional scopeId override for the target resolve. May be a literal id or a client-evaluated expression (e.g., "request.scopeId").

asOf.description: Optional time-travel timestamp override for the target resolve. Typically a literal RFC3339 timestamp, but may also be a client-evaluated expression (e.g., "request.asOf").

params.description: View-specific knobs to merge into the resolve request for the target view. Values may be literals or client-evaluated expressions (e.g., "node.id", "edge.fromId").

limits.description: Optional limits override for the target resolve.

overlayKey.description: Optional stable key used by the UI to identify/toggle an overlay result (when drilldown mode is "overlay"). May be a literal or a client-evaluated expression (e.g., "edge.id").
